org.californiabitcoin/product.idealUseCase: Run the first no-cost evaluation when you need to see which maintained Bitcoin topics and evidence match a query.
org.californiabitcoin/product.whenNotToUse: Claim-level adjudication; use verify-claim after evaluating coverage.

description: FREE. FREE, no account required. Search canonical Bitcoin Knowledge Atlas topics and related history to evaluate coverage on the caller's real question. Run the first no-cost evaluation when you need to see which maintained Bitcoin topics and evidence match a query. Use to discover maintained topic coverage. Do not use when a canonical topic id is already known or when a final evidence-grade answer is required.

inputSchema.description: Input for Search Bitcoin Knowledge. Use the documented fields exactly; unknown fields are rejected.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked knowledge matches to return.

query.description: Bitcoin topic, concept, event, person, protocol feature, or research phrase to search.

name: search_bitcoin_knowledge

outputSchema.description: Structured California Bitcoin result with operation-specific research, evidence, provenance, coverage, freshness, trust, and next-step fields.

title: Search Bitcoin Knowledge
